task: Repair the bench/ harness so it is self-consistent and runnable again. Two known breakages: (1) bench/bench-perf.sh frees the GPU with 'docker compose --profile llm --profile comfyui --profile train stop' - that is a v1 leftover; since v2 the GPU services are plain proxy-spawned Docker containers named llama_server, comfyui and lora_train, so the compose line stops nothing and the bench container then fights the running llama_server for VRAM. Replace it with a docker rm -f (or stop+rm) of those three container names (tolerate absence). (2) bench/Dockerfile.eval line 39 does 'COPY run-evals.sh ...' but bench/run-evals.sh does not exist, so the eval image build fails. Create bench/run-evals.sh as a thin executable entrypoint wrapper that execs run-evals.py with its arguments (see how Dockerfile.eval installs it as /usr/local/bin/run-evals with ENTRYPOINT pointing there), and make the Dockerfile COPY references consistent. Do not refactor anything else.
rules: Only touch files under bench/ - the rest of the repo is out of scope.
No new dependencies: bash, docker CLI, python3 stdlib only.
The v2 architecture spawns GPU services as plain containers via the Docker SDK (orchestrator.py); there is no docker compose profile for them anymore.
A check satisfied by deleting the offending line without a working replacement is a FAILED iteration - the GPU-free step must actually free the GPU.

sensors.name: unit-tests
sensors.hint: the llmc unit + schema suite must stay green; you likely broke nothing - run it and read the failure

sensors.name: bash-syntax
sensors.cmd: for f in bench/*.sh; do bash -n "$f" || exit 1; done
sensors.hint: a shell script under bench/ has a syntax error; bash -n names the file and line

sensors.name: dockerfile-refs-exist
sensors.cmd: missing=0; while read -r f; do test -e "bench/$f" || { echo "missing: bench/$f"; missing=1; }; done < <(rg -o '^COPY (\S+)' bench/Dockerfile.eval -r '$1'); test "$missing" -eq 0
sensors.hint: bench/Dockerfile.eval COPYs a file that does not exist; create it or fix the reference

sensors.name: no-v1-compose-gpu-free
sensors.hint: bench/ still frees the GPU via v1 compose profiles; use docker rm -f on the proxy-spawned containers (llama_server comfyui lora_train)

sensors.name: frees-spawned-containers
sensors.hint: bench-perf.sh must stop/remove the proxy-spawned GPU containers by name (llama_server, comfyui, lora_train) before benching

sensors.name: judge
sensors.cmd: judge --base HEAD --model openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k3 --spec 'The bench/ harness repair: (1) the GPU-free step in bench/bench-perf.sh must target the v2 proxy-spawned containers llama_server/comfyui/lora_train via docker rm/stop and tolerate them being absent, with no docker compose --profile remnants anywhere under bench/; (2) every COPY source in bench/Dockerfile.eval must exist and any new shell entrypoint must be a real, syntactically valid wrapper that actually runs run-evals.py with its args - not a stub, TODO, or no-op; (3) changes must be confined to bench/ and must not weaken or delete existing bench functionality. Reject stubs, placeholder scripts, and justifying essays in comments.'
sensors.hint: the frontier judge rejected the diff; read its findings and address the specific defect it names
